native.why: Logbook (the user's flights) already carries the in-list banner after row 5 (logbook_screen.dart:189-194), and the founder said to keep the banner. A native in the same list would mean two ads in one personal record. The weather lists (lib/screens/weather_screen.dart:288-296 raw PIREP/METAR list; :307-330 G-AIRMET hazards) are go/no-go safety data. No ad belongs between hazard reports.

Delete it.
